name: Workflow A - Ingest, Deduplicate, Rewrite & Store (Dynamic)

parameters.query: SELECT id as source_id, name as source_name, url as feed_url FROM news_sources WHERE is_active = true;
SELECT source_url FROM news_drafts WHERE source_url = $1 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO news_drafts (source_type, source_url, original_title, original_content, ai_title, ai_content, image_url, status, target_platforms) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb) RETURNING id, ai_title;
